contentList.content:
All class resources restored. Harmful conditions are cleansed and cannot be applied again while the Eclipse lasts.

While the Eclipse lasts, attacks and spells also deal [1] and bypass all Resistances.

Eclipse grants Immunity to[5],[6],[7] and[8], halves every other kind of damage taken, and adds +[4] Armour Class and +[9] Proficiency Bonus.

Eclipse also grants Immunity to all harmful conditions and effects, including being Stunned, Paralysed, Frightened, Charmed, Blinded, Restrained, Poisoned, Dominated or knocked Prone.

On activation, every player must succeed a Constitution Saving Throw or be Stunned for 1 turn, and an Intelligence Saving Throw or be Slowed. All players also lose any Sanctuary.

Caught in the Eclipse. You must succeed a DC [1] Constitution Saving Throw or be Stunned, and a DC [2] Intelligence Saving Throw or be Slowed. You also lose any Sanctuary, and cannot regain it for [3] turns.
